title: Backpropagation
description: Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams publish 'Learning representations by back-propagating errors' in Nature.

title: Deep Blue

title: AlexNet

title: GANs
description: Ian Goodfellow et al. introduce generative adversarial networks.

title: AlphaGo
description: DeepMind's AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol 4–1 at Go.

title: Transformer
description: 'Attention Is All You Need' introduces the Transformer architecture.

title: BERT
description: Google's BERT popularizes large-scale pretraining + fine-tuning for language.

title: GPT-3
description: OpenAI's 175B-parameter GPT-3 shows few-shot learning emerging from scale.

title: AlphaFold 2
description: AlphaFold 2 effectively solves protein structure prediction at CASP14.

title: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI releases ChatGPT, bringing LLM chat assistants to the mainstream.

title: GPT-4
description: OpenAI releases GPT-4, a multimodal frontier model.
